args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

Proposed change: address the reported issue in this file.
Evidence: When a new file is chosen via onChange on the file input, setFile is called, but setProblem(null) is not called, leaving the previous upload error on screen until the user clicks Upload again.

label: bug
file: src/components/UploadForm.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

When a new file is chosen via onChange on the file input, setFile is called, but setProblem(null) is not called, leaving the previous upload error on screen until the user clicks Upload again.
